name: Web Search and Fetch
description: Practice searching the web and fetching web page content.

tasks.description: Use the web_search action to search for 'Rust programming language features'. Write the top result's title and URL to search_result.txt.
tasks.expected_outcome: search_result.txt exists with web search results

tasks.description: Use web_fetch to fetch the content from 'https://example.com'. Save the fetched markdown content to fetched_page.txt.
